thread:
alex.g: Quick PSA — putting out a tiny checklist before today's changelog cutoff (18:00 PT). Please do a 2-min sweep on entries you own. :wave:
eng-release-bot: Reminder: changelog cutoff in 2 hours. Add entries to the release-notes/ draft or they'll miss this cut.
maya: Quick Q — what's the required fields again? owner/component/summary?
alex.g: Yep. Minimal shape we want is: owner, component, short summary, and whether it's a user-facing change. Example:```
- owner: @sam
- component: runtime
- summary: reduce kv-cache memory for long-seq models
- user-facing: no
```
sam: Should the summary be one sentence or can it be a bullet list?
alex.g: One concise sentence please. If you need to add more context link to the PR from the summary. Keep changelog entries skimmable.
prashant: Heads up — changelog-lint is failing on a couple of entries that use full sentences with trailing periods. Our linter prefers no trailing period and tag format: `[component] short summary` (we're moving to that).
julie: Where do I run the linter locally?
prashant: from repo root: `./scripts/changelog/lint --files release-notes/*.md` or CI job `ci/changelog-lint`.
maya: Is there an example of the preferred tag style?
alex.g: Use this tiny template so entries are consistent:```
[docs] clarify api pagination for embeddings — avoid returning duplicates
[dedicated] reserve slot accounting fix — prevents double-charging on reschedule
```
eng-release-bot: Auto-check: a11y checklist not applicable. CI changelog-lint job queued.
sam: If I'm owner for a PR that touches multiple components, do I add multiple tags?
alex.g: Tag the primary component only, and mention others in the PR body. If it's truly cross-cutting, add `[{runtime},{docs}]` but try to avoid multi-tags for small fixes.
julie: Pinging owners for entries in the runtime bucket: @sam @prashant — can you glance?
sam: Looking now. I fixed my entry formatting and pushed to the draft.
prashant: I fixed two entries (removed trailing periods, converted to single-sentence form). Ran `./scripts/changelog/lint` locally, passes.
maya: Updated mine and added a link to the PR.
alex.g: Awesome — last ask: please add a one-line impact note if the change affects customers (eg, migration, opt-in, perf diff).
sam: Added `impact: minor, no migration` to my entry as well.
julie: All green from my side.
alex.g: Thanks all — if you can't get to it by 17:30 PT ping me and we'll triage. Otherwise we'll close the cut at 18:00 and roll the release notes. :thumbsup:
eng-release-bot: Changelog cutoff reached (18:00 PT). Draft snapshot created: /releases/drafts/2026-03-17-notes.md
alex.g: Final note — keep entries short, owner must be a person (not a team) so we can follow up easily.
